Create a tranquil sunlit Moroccan medina inspired by Chefchaouen. Arrange roughly fifteen to twenty adjoining two- to four-story buildings along both sides of a broad straight paved road, with puddles, raised curbs, and narrow cobbled sidewalks. Layer the facades with alleys, courtyards, horseshoe arches, exterior stairs, timber galleries, and balconies. Use weathered blue, white, turquoise, coral, and peach stucco, exposed dark masonry, orange roof tiles, and occasional blue terraces or pyramidal roofs. Make a tall blue tower house with a projecting dark wooden room the landmark. Add banded arched openings, flowering vines, palms, twin-lantern streetlights, and a few wooden benches.

Make a tall blue tower house with a projecting dark wooden room the landmark. Add banded arched openings, flowering vines, palms, twin-lantern streetlights, and a few wooden benches.
